name: FoundationTipJar
title: The Ghost of the Unicorn
tagline: A lingering relic from the Frontier Thawing era, still holding the memory of original tokens.

chapters.heading: The birth of the foundation tip jar
paragraphs: Marigolds scent the air as we remember February 11, 2016. On that day, the FoundationTipJar was born during the Frontier Thawing. It was written into a block, one page of Ethereum's shared record book.
A wallet ending in 9adb brought the contract into the world. It is a small program that lives on Ethereum. It allowed direct donations and gave out the original Unicorn token.
The contract is now about 10.7 years old. It sits quietly on the chain like a ghost of the early days.

chapters.heading: The spirit of the unicorn
paragraphs: The contract sat as a quiet tool for transparency. It let people send Ether directly to the Foundation. Each gift was a public act of coordination. In return, the contract issued a small experimental token called the Unicorn token. It served as a symbolic thank you for those who joined the journey.

This old ghost showed how early leaders viewed the chain. It turned institutional funding into a public experiment. The Unicorn token later lived on in other experiments like the Unicorn Meat Grinder Association DAO. It saw 1425 transactions during its life.

chapters.heading: The knocking
paragraphs: The FoundationTipJar sits quiet in the dark. It holds about 4.3 ETH inside its belly. People still reach out to touch it.
Some voices come to change membership. Others arrive to make new proposals or cast a vote. A few still come to execute a proposal.
The code remains on the chain. It waits for the next visitor.
